name: GroupAssistBench final evaluation set

files.items.jsonl: evaluation records (query, gt / gt_atoms / distractor_atoms for L1, criteria for L2, cut_idx, mem_span)
files.items_full.jsonl: construction records of the same 2395 items: anchors (turn, fact, type, evidence), provenance, pos_turn/src_turn, event_id, pairing
files.contexts.json: {group: [[turn, speaker, text], ...]} full anonymised conversation, text cut at 2000 chars
files.cutoffs.json: {iid: cut_idx} a system may read only turns before this one (turn < cut_idx)
files.profiles.json: {group: [{member, slot, fact, turn}, ...]} member profiles; entries with turn > 0 are extracted from the conversation and point to the turn that establishes them, entries with turn = 0 are member background information
files.manifest.json: {"<group>/<L>/<D>": [iid, ...]} the 2395 ids bucketed by group, layer and difficulty

base_items.note: selected from the step-04 pool of the 50 group runs (section 7 of the README)

d3v2_items.note: cut_idx may be moved earlier than the construction record (fallback), never later

annotator_ids: human labels are recorded as anonymous ids (human:annotator_a / human:annotator_b)
